messages: Support check failed: the claim that the central legal question was whether the admission of the plea allocution violated the Confrontation Clause under Crawford is not backed by any supplied evidence.

Support check failed: the claim that the case addresses the scope of the Confrontation Clause as a core protection for criminal defendants against testimonial hearsay is not supported by any supplied evidence attributed to Justice Sotomayor.

Support check failed: the claim that Justice Thomas said the dispute over the Reid rule’s relationship to the Confrontation Clause could affect how courts handle evidence that a defendant “opens the door” to otherwise inadmissible testimony is not supported by the supplied evidence.
Overstatement check failed: the three unsupported claims above overstate what the evidence actually says.
